name: listen
purpose: Opt-in, on-device microphone timing: compares drum onsets with the beats of a silent round.

beats.doc: state key holding the round's beat times in seconds on the page audio clock

tolerance.doc: ms counted as on time; default 30

window.doc: ms either side searched for an onset; default 150

calibrate.doc: offer the tap-to-calibrate step; default true

out.doc: state key receiving [{beat, verdict: early|on|late|missed, ms}]
